sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: With many girls growing up in southern Italy in the early 60s, Serafina Locolco was expected to marry young and start a family of her own.
sentences.zh: 在60年代初的意大利南部，许多女孩在成长过程中都被期望早早结婚，组建自己的家庭。

sentences.en: By age 15, Serafina had chosen the man she wanted to be her future husband, a 20-year-old leather cutter from her neighbourhood named Pietro Santoro.
sentences.zh: 15岁时，塞拉菲娜就已经选定了她未来的丈夫人选，那是她邻居的一位20岁的皮革切割工，名叫彼得罗·桑托罗。

sentences.en: In contrast to socially progressive northern Italy, those on the island of Sicily still clung to the ancient belief that a girl's worth was measured by her chasteness.
sentences.zh: 与社会进步的意大利北部形成鲜明对比的是，西西里岛的人们依然固守着古老的观念，认为女孩的价值取决于她的贞洁。

sentences.en: If she was a virgin before marriage, she was considered pure and worthy.
sentences.zh: 如果她在婚前保持童贞，她就被认为是纯洁且有价值的。

sentences.en: If not, she was seen as shameful and immoral.
sentences.zh: 反之，她则会被视为可耻且道德败坏。

sentences.en: No Sicilian man would marry what they judged a dishonoured woman.
sentences.zh: 没有西西里男人会娶一个被他们判定为“名誉扫地”的女人。

sentences.en: They feared her dishonour would jeopardise the family standing in the community and damage the marriage prospects of other female family members.
sentences.zh: 他们担心她的失贞会危及家族在社区中的地位，并损害家中其他女性成员的婚嫁前景。

sentences.en: Accordingly, Sicilian girls and young women were required to dress modestly and weren't permitted to socially interact with unmarried men.
sentences.zh: 因此，西西里女孩和年轻女性被要求穿着保守，且不允许与未婚男性进行社交互动。

sentences.en: Courtships between young couples were strictly controlled by their families, and in Serafina Locolco's case, her father did not like Pietro Santoro.
sentences.zh: 年轻情侣之间的交往受到家庭的严格管控，而在塞拉菲娜·洛科尔科的案例中，她的父亲并不喜欢彼得罗·桑托罗。

sentences.en: Without his approval, there would be no marriage.
sentences.zh: 没有他的首肯，婚事就无法进行。

sentences.en: One day in the summer of 1962, Pietro and Serafina performed what was known as a fouetina, an elopement of sorts.
sentences.zh: 1962年夏天的某一天，彼得罗和塞拉菲娜上演了一出所谓的“私奔”。

sentences.en: They spent a week together hidden in the countryside, and upon her return home, Serafina informed her father that she was now a dishonoured woman.
sentences.zh: 他们躲在乡下待了一周，塞拉菲娜回到家后告诉父亲，她现在已经是一个名誉扫地的女人了。

sentences.en: Her father understood the situation before him.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲明白眼前的处境。

sentences.en: His own honour, that of his family name and of both his daughters, was at stake.
sentences.zh: 他自己的名誉、家族的名声以及两个女儿的清白，全都危在旦夕。

sentences.en: Despite his ill feelings toward Pietro, Serafina's father felt he had no choice.
sentences.zh: 尽管对彼得罗心存不满，但塞拉菲娜的父亲觉得他别无选择。

sentences.en: According to Sicilian culture dating back millennia, the dishonour could be entirely undone, repaired and restored by the matrimonio reparatore,
sentences.zh: 根据延续了数千年的西西里文化，这种名誉损失可以通过“补救婚姻”来完全抵消、修复和挽回，

sentences.en: the marriage between the girl and her lover.
sentences.zh: 也就是女孩与她的情人结婚。

sentences.en: About 12 months later, another Sicilian man, 23-year-old Filippo Melodia, set his eyes on the most beautiful girl he had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 大约12个月后，另一位西西里男子，23岁的菲利波·梅洛迪亚，看中了他所见过最美丽的女孩。

sentences.en: In the north-western Sicilian town of Valcomo, many locals believed that Franca Viola's beauty was destined to lift her family out of poverty.
sentences.zh: 在西西里西北部的小镇阿尔卡莫，许多当地人都认为弗兰卡·维奥拉的美貌注定能让她的家庭摆脱贫困。

sentences.en: Despite all the fanfare regarding her looks, Franca was an unassuming 15-year-old.
sentences.zh: 尽管外界对她的美貌大加赞赏，但弗兰卡只是一个谦逊的15岁少女。

sentences.en: She aspired to complete her education, live a comfortable life, and travel the world.
sentences.zh: 她渴望完成学业，过上舒适的生活，并环游世界。

sentences.en: She also dreamed of falling in love.
sentences.zh: 她也梦想着坠入爱河。

sentences.en: Unlike Franca Viola, whose family were poor farmers, Filippo Melodia was born into wealth.
sentences.zh: 与出身贫寒农户的弗兰卡·维奥拉不同，菲利波·梅洛迪亚生来富有。

sentences.en: He was the nephew of the undisputed boss of the Cosa Nostra, the Sicilian mafia.
sentences.zh: 他是西西里黑手党“科萨·诺斯特拉”无可争议的老大的侄子。

sentences.en: Filippo enjoyed all of the privileges that such an association offered.
sentences.zh: 菲利波享受着这种身份所带来的一切特权。

sentences.en: He drove around town in a white Alfa Romeo Giulietta and spent his money freely, buying rounds of drinks for his friends at the bar almost daily.
sentences.zh: 他开着一辆白色的阿尔法·罗密欧朱丽叶塔在镇上兜风，花钱大手大脚，几乎每天都在酒吧里为朋友们买单请客。

sentences.en: Given Alcamo was a stronghold for the Sicilian mafia, Filippo's position as a future leader was assured.
sentences.zh: 鉴于阿尔卡莫是西西里黑手党的大本营，菲利波作为未来领导者的地位是稳固的。

sentences.en: With his money, good looks and status, Filippo was one of the town's most eligible bachelors.
sentences.zh: 凭借金钱、外貌和地位，菲利波是镇上最抢手的单身汉之一。

sentences.en: Yet, he only had eyes for Franca Viola.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的眼里只有弗兰卡·维奥拉。

sentences.en: The pair had made an impact on each other as they exchanged glances and greetings around town.
sentences.zh: 两人在镇上交换眼神和问候时，就已经对彼此产生了影响。

sentences.en: Franca had formed the belief that there was a decent husband hidden behind Filippo's flashy exterior and told her parents that she would be open to a courtship with him.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡认为菲利波浮夸的外表下藏着一颗正直的心，于是告诉父母，她愿意与他交往。

sentences.en: Franca's father, Bernardo, was well aware of Filippo Melodia.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡的父亲贝尔纳多对菲利波·梅洛迪亚的情况了如指掌。

sentences.en: He'd heard the many stories of Filippo terrorising the neighbourhoods of Alcamo, speeding through the narrow streets in his Giulietta and flashing around his 9mm pistol.
sentences.zh: 他听过许多关于菲利波在阿尔卡莫街区横行霸道的故事，比如开着他的朱丽叶塔在狭窄的街道上飞驰，以及到处炫耀他的9毫米手枪。

sentences.en: Bernardo was also aware that the local police had their eye on Filippo.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多也知道当地警方一直在盯着菲利波。

sentences.en: As a hard-working, honest and humble man, Bernardo Viola had little respect for the young Marfioso.
sentences.zh: 作为一个勤劳、诚实且谦卑的人，贝尔纳多·维奥拉对这位年轻的黑手党成员毫无敬意。

sentences.en: Days after Franca told her father about her growing feelings for Filippo, he arrived at the Viola house to introduce himself to her family and begin the courtship process.
sentences.zh: 在弗兰卡告诉父亲她对菲利波的好感与日俱增几天后，菲利波来到维奥拉家，向她的家人做自我介绍，并开启求爱流程。

sentences.en: Once inside, Filippo announced his intention to be engaged to Franca.
sentences.zh: 进屋后，菲利波宣布了他想与弗兰卡订婚的意图。

sentences.en: Bernardo was not easily intimidated.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多并没有那么容易被吓倒。

sentences.en: He wanted his daughter to marry a man who would take good care of her.
sentences.zh: 他希望女儿嫁给一个能好好照顾她的男人。

sentences.en: Filippo retorted that there was no better man in Alcamo.
sentences.zh: 菲利波反驳说，在阿尔卡莫没有比他更好的人了。

sentences.en: Bernardo then implied that he would prefer Franca marry a man who worked for a living.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多随即暗示，他更希望弗兰卡嫁给一个靠劳动谋生的男人。

sentences.en: Filippo was insulted by the remark, but remained quiet.
sentences.zh: 菲利波被这番话激怒了，但他保持了沉默。

sentences.en: Eventually, Bernardo broke the silence.
sentences.zh: 最终，贝尔纳多打破了沉默。

sentences.en: Franca herself had expressed an interest in Filippo, so Bernardo was willing to consider an engagement between them on one condition.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡本人对菲利波表现出了兴趣，所以贝尔纳多愿意考虑他们之间的婚事，但有一个条件。

sentences.en: They got to know each other firSt.
sentences.zh: 他们得先互相了解一下。

sentences.en: Filippo was not the type to take orders from someone he considered a peasant, and he wouldn't have tolerated such disrespect for any other girl.
sentences.zh: 菲利波不是那种会听从他眼中“农民”指令的人，如果换作其他女孩，他绝不会容忍这种不敬。

sentences.en: But he wanted Franca Viola as his wife, so he was willing to do as her father asked.
sentences.zh: 但他想娶弗兰卡·维奥拉为妻，所以他愿意照她父亲说的做。

sentences.en: The following week, Filippo and Franca sat side by side on a sofa inside the Viola house under the watchful eye of Franca's mother, Vita.
sentences.zh: 接下来的一个星期，菲利波和弗兰卡在弗兰卡母亲维塔的注视下，并排坐在维奥拉家的沙发上。

sentences.en: Franca was initially charmed by Filippo, who confessed to Franca that he was crazy about her.
sentences.zh: 起初，弗兰卡被菲利波迷住了，菲利波向她坦白自己为她疯狂。

sentences.en: However, after a number of months, Franca realised that she didn't harbour any romantic feelings for Filippo.
sentences.zh: 然而，几个月后，弗兰卡意识到她对菲利波并没有任何浪漫的感觉。

sentences.en: He boasted constantly of his family's wealth, his car, and his connections to the mafia.
sentences.zh: 他不断吹嘘家族的财富、他的车以及他与黑手党的关系。

sentences.en: He was also being looked into for a string of motorcycle thefts.
sentences.zh: 他当时还因一系列摩托车盗窃案而受到调查。

sentences.en: Filippo had scoffed at Franca's plans for the future, insisting that she should be satisfied simply by becoming his wife.
sentences.zh: 菲利波对弗兰卡的未来规划嗤之以鼻，坚持认为她只要能成为他的妻子就该感到满足了。

sentences.en: Franca had glimpsed what her life with Filippo Melodia would be like, and she was not impressed.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡已经预见到了她与菲利波·梅洛迪亚婚后的生活会是什么样子，她对此并不满意。

sentences.en: The next time Filippo called at the Viola house, Franca didn't appear.
sentences.zh: 下一次菲利波再来维奥拉家拜访时，弗兰卡没有露面。

sentences.en: Instead, her father informed the young man that he had failed his teSt.
sentences.zh: 相反，她的父亲告诉这个年轻人，他没能通过考验。

sentences.en: Without Bernardo's approval, Franca and Filippo's marriage would not go ahead.
sentences.zh: 没有贝尔纳多的首肯，弗兰卡和菲利波的婚事就不会进行。

sentences.en: For the whole of 1964, the Viola family did not hear a word from Filippo Melodia.
sentences.zh: 整个1964年，维奥拉一家都没有收到菲利波·梅洛迪亚的任何消息。

sentences.en: After having been rejected by Franca and her father,
sentences.zh: 在被弗兰卡和她父亲拒绝后，

sentences.en: Filippo had left Sicily and spent the year in Germany to save face.
sentences.zh: 菲利波离开了西西里，在德国待了一年以挽回面子。

sentences.en: By early 1965, the atmosphere in Alcamo had changed.
sentences.zh: 到了1965年初，阿尔卡莫的气氛发生了变化。

sentences.en: Many high-ranking mafioso, including Filippo's uncle, had been arrested.
sentences.zh: 包括菲利波的叔叔在内的许多黑手党高层都被捕了。

sentences.en: The Cosa Nostra no longer had the same stranglehold over the town.
sentences.zh: “科萨·诺斯特拉”对该镇的控制力已大不如前。

sentences.en: Those who remained free kept a low profile, wary of Alcamo's new police commissioner, Lorenzo Camilleri.
sentences.zh: 那些依然逍遥法外的人行事变得低调，因为他们忌惮阿尔卡莫的新任警察局长洛伦佐·卡米莱里。

sentences.en: Upon his return to Alcamo, Filippo was keen to pick up where he left off.
sentences.zh: 回到阿尔卡莫后，菲利波急于重拾旧好。

sentences.en: He wanted what he thought was owed to him, the mafioso lifestyle and Franca Viola.
sentences.zh: 他想要回他认为属于自己的东西：黑手党的生活方式，以及弗兰卡·维奥拉。

sentences.en: His desire for her had only intensified during his absence.
sentences.zh: 他对她的渴望在离开期间反而愈发强烈了。

sentences.en: In early May 1965, Filippo spied Bernardo Viola in town and approached him.
sentences.zh: 1965年5月初，菲利波在镇上发现了贝尔纳多·维奥拉，并走上前去。

sentences.en: In a callback to their first conversation,
sentences.zh: 在重提他们第一次谈话时，

sentences.en: Filippo told Bernardo that he had been working while living in Germany, hoping to impress the older man.
sentences.zh: 菲利波告诉贝尔纳多，他在德国生活期间一直在工作，希望能给这位长辈留下好印象。

sentences.en: Bernardo replied,
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多回答道：

sentences.en: It was not a thing before and it is not a thing now.
sentences.zh: “以前不行，现在也不行。”

sentences.en: Franca has not missed you and she can find a better husband than you.
sentences.zh: “弗兰卡并没有想念你，她能找到比你更好的丈夫。”

sentences.en: A few weeks later, on Friday May 28, Bernardo arrived at his farm only to find the warehouse where he kept his farming tools on fire.
sentences.zh: 几周后的5月28日星期五，贝尔纳多回到农场时，发现存放农具的仓库着火了。

sentences.en: Upon discovering several empty petrol cans around the building,
sentences.zh: 在发现建筑物周围有几个空汽油桶后，

sentences.en: Bernardo headed into town to report the arson to the police.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多前往镇上向警方报告这起纵火案。

sentences.en: On the way, he crossed paths with Filippo Melodia.
sentences.zh: 在路上，他与菲利波·梅洛迪亚狭路相逢。

sentences.en: The young man smiled, as if in triumph.
sentences.zh: 那个年轻人笑了，仿佛胜券在握。

sentences.en: Later that evening, Bernardo was given the message, the fire was just a warning.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候，贝尔纳多收到了一条口信：那场火只是一个警告。

sentences.en: Two months later, 500 vines were prematurely cut and destroyed on the Viola farm.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，维奥拉农场的500株葡萄藤被提前砍伐并毁坏了。

sentences.en: This was a devastating financial blow to the family, whose entire income was derived from their harveSt.
sentences.zh: 这对家庭来说是一个毁灭性的经济打击，因为他们的全部收入都来自收成。

sentences.en: They would just have to make do with the remaining crops.
sentences.zh: 他们只能勉强靠剩下的作物过活。

sentences.en: However, by October, these two had been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 然而，到了十月，这些作物也全被毁了。

sentences.en: Bernardo had arrived to find sheep and cattle grazing in his field.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多赶到时，发现羊群和牛群正在他的田里吃草。

sentences.en: There was nothing left.
sentences.zh: 什么都不剩了。

sentences.en: The destruction of his warehouse, tools and crops meant that the Viola family would not have any money for the coming year.
sentences.zh: 仓库、工具和作物的毁坏意味着维奥拉一家在接下来的一年里将没有任何收入。

sentences.en: When winter arrived, they would be forced to turn to public charity for food to eat.
sentences.zh: 冬天来临时，他们将被迫依靠公共救济来维持生计。

sentences.en: Bernardo maintained a cheerful public facade, but privately, he was humiliated.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多在公众面前保持着乐观的姿态，但私下里，他感到备受屈辱。

sentences.en: The following day, Filippo Melodia and two of his friends arrived at Bernardo's farm.
sentences.zh: 第二天，菲利波·梅洛迪亚和他的两个朋友来到了贝尔纳多的农场。

sentences.en: Filippo informed Bernardo that he must forfeit his farming land within three days.
sentences.zh: 菲利波通知贝尔纳多，他必须在三天内放弃他的农田。

sentences.en: He then lifted his shirt to reveal a 9mm pistol tucked into his waistband.
sentences.zh: 随后，他掀起衬衫，露出了别在腰间的一把9毫米手枪。

sentences.en: There was no question that Filippo was responsible for the damage to the Viola farm, but without any proof, there was nothing the police could do.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，菲利波应对维奥拉农场的损失负责，但由于没有任何证据，警方也无能为力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Franca Viola had become so terrified of Filippo that she barely left her home in fear of what he'd do next.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，弗兰卡·维奥拉对菲利波感到极度恐惧，她几乎不敢离开家门，生怕他接下来会做出什么事。

sentences.en: On Christmas Day, Filippo Melodia gathered his crew.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节那天，菲利波·梅洛迪亚召集了他的手下。

sentences.en: Let Franca enjoy mass with her family, he told his boys.
sentences.zh: “让弗兰卡和家人好好过个弥撒吧，”他对手下们说。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, they would ride.
sentences.zh: “明天，我们就行动。”

sentences.en: At 7am on Sunday December 26, 1965, two men on a scooter slowly rode down the narrow streets of central Alcamo.
sentences.zh: 1965年12月26日星期日早上7点，两名男子骑着一辆踏板车，缓慢地穿过阿尔卡莫市中心的狭窄街道。

sentences.en: They turned into Villara Rancho, passing the near-identical sandstone-coloured buildings that lined the street until they reached number 41.
sentences.zh: 他们转入维拉拉兰乔，经过街道两旁几乎一模一样的砂岩色建筑，直到抵达41号。

sentences.en: They idled in place for a moment before moving a little further away to an acceptable vantage point.
sentences.zh: 他们在原地停留了片刻，然后又稍微移远了一些，到了一个视野良好的位置。

sentences.en: Eventually, they saw a short, slightly paunched man in a flat cap and jacket leave the building.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们看到一个身材矮小、略微发福，戴着平顶帽和夹克的男人离开了那栋建筑。

sentences.en: Once he was out of sight, the scooter's engine buzzed.
sentences.zh: 当他消失在视线中后，踏板车的引擎声响了起来。

sentences.en: And the two men hurriedly disappeared.
sentences.zh: 那两名男子匆忙离开了。

sentences.en: About 30 minutes later, a blue Fiat Seicento and a white Alfa Romeo Giulietta screeched to a halt outside number 41.
sentences.zh: 大约30分钟后，一辆蓝色菲亚特600和一辆白色阿尔法·罗密欧朱丽叶塔在41号门外急刹停下。

sentences.en: Several gunshots were fired into the air as a warning to residents to stay inside and mind their business.
sentences.zh: 几声枪响划破天空，作为警告，让居民们待在屋里，不要多管闲事。

sentences.en: Twelve masked and armed men then piled out of the cars and forced their way inside the Viola home.
sentences.zh: 随后，十二名蒙面武装人员从车里冲出，强行闯入了维奥拉家中。

sentences.en: Vita Viola screamed for her daughter to run, knowing the men had come to take Franca away.
sentences.zh: 维塔·维奥拉尖叫着让女儿快跑，她知道这些人是来带走弗兰卡的。

sentences.en: Vita tried to fight them off, but they knocked her down and kept her pinned to the ground.
sentences.zh: 维塔试图反抗，但他们将她打倒在地并死死按住。

sentences.en: Franca rushed upstairs, only to be chased down by four men who dragged her back down and out the front door.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡冲上楼，却被四名男子追上，他们将她拖回楼下并拽出了前门。

sentences.en: Franca's eight-year-old brother Mariano clung to her legs, refusing to let go even when he was struck over and over.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡八岁的弟弟马里亚诺紧紧抱住她的腿，即使被反复击打也不肯松手。

sentences.en: Franca and Mariano were thrown into the Alfa Romeo Giulietta.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡和马里亚诺被扔进了那辆阿尔法·罗密欧朱丽叶塔里。

sentences.en: After the car doors slammed shut, the two men who were still inside the house released their grip on Vita, who immediately ran outside after her children.
sentences.zh: 车门关上后，留在屋里的两名男子松开了对维塔的控制，她立刻跑出屋外去追赶她的孩子们。

sentences.en: Before she could reach the car, she was punched in the head from behind and fell to the ground.
sentences.zh: 还没等她追上车，就被人从背后重击头部，倒在了地上。

sentences.en: A dozen more gunshots were fired into the air before the Giulietta and Seicento sped away.
sentences.zh: 在朱丽叶塔和菲亚特疾驰而去之前，空中又响起了十几声枪响。

sentences.en: Bernardo Viola returned home as quickly as he could and reported the kidnapping of Franca and Mariano to Commissioner Lorenzo Camilleri.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多·维奥拉以最快速度赶回家，并向洛伦佐·卡米莱里局长报告了弗兰卡和马里亚诺被绑架的消息。

sentences.en: Vita Viola knew for certain who had kidnapped her children.
sentences.zh: 维塔·维奥拉确信是谁绑架了她的孩子。

sentences.en: Although he'd been wearing a mask,
sentences.zh: 尽管他戴着面具，

sentences.en: Vita had locked eyes with Filippo Melodia as he dragged Franca away.
sentences.zh: 但在菲利波·梅洛迪亚拖走弗兰卡时，维塔与他四目相对。

sentences.en: Despite knowing who was responsible,
sentences.zh: 尽管知道是谁干的，

sentences.en: Bernardo and Vita were at a loss.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多和维塔却束手无策。

sentences.en: Wary of Filippo's mafia connections, the couple's neighbours refused to offer assistance or information.
sentences.zh: 由于忌惮菲利波的黑手党背景，邻居们拒绝提供任何帮助或信息。

sentences.en: Fortunately for the Violas,
sentences.zh: 对维奥拉一家来说幸运的是，

sentences.en: Commissioner Lorenzo Camilleri wasn't one to just sit around and wait.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐·卡米莱里局长并不是一个只会坐着等待的人。

sentences.en: He immediately began searching for Franca.
sentences.zh: 他立即开始搜寻弗兰卡。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Filippo Melodia sped away from Alcamo and into the countryside.
sentences.zh: 菲利波·梅洛迪亚从阿尔卡莫疾驰而出，驶向乡间。

sentences.en: Behind him,
sentences.zh: 在他身后，

sentences.en: Franca and Mariano Viola clung tightly to one another in the back seat.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡和马里亚诺·维奥拉在后座紧紧依偎在一起。

sentences.en: Filippo told Franca that after he was done with her, she would not be able to marry any other man but him.
sentences.zh: 菲利波告诉弗兰卡，等他玩腻了，她就再也嫁不了别人，只能嫁给他。

sentences.en: In defiance, she shouted that she did not love him.
sentences.zh: 她大声反抗，说她根本不爱他。

sentences.en: Filippo laughed and retorted,
sentences.zh: 菲利波大笑着反驳道：

sentences.en: Who cares?
sentences.zh: “谁在乎呢？”

sentences.en: The Giulietta eventually came to a stop in front of a remote farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 朱丽叶塔最终在一座偏僻的农舍前停了下来。

sentences.en: Eight-year-old Mariano was pried away from his sister and driven back towards Alcamo.
sentences.zh: 八岁的马里亚诺被强行从姐姐身边拉开，开车送回了阿尔卡莫方向。

sentences.en: He was later found abandoned on the outskirts of town.
sentences.zh: 他后来被发现遗弃在镇郊。

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Franca was dragged inside the farmhouse screaming, but there was nobody around to hear her cries for help.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡尖叫着被拖进农舍，但周围空无一人，没人能听到她的求救声。

sentences.en: For six days, For six days, she was starved, taunted, and insulted by Filippo Melodia.
sentences.zh: 整整六天，整整六天，她一直遭受着菲利波·梅洛迪亚的饥饿折磨、嘲讽和侮辱。

sentences.en: By the seventh day,
sentences.zh: 到了第七天，

sentences.en: Franca was weak.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡已经非常虚弱。

sentences.en: She lay on the floor, semi-conscious, and barely able to move.
sentences.zh: 她躺在地板上，半昏迷状态，几乎无法动弹。

sentences.en: Filippo then raped her for the first time.
sentences.zh: 随后，菲利波第一次强奸了她。

sentences.en: He knew under any circumstances where an unmarried girl or young woman loses her virginity, even in the case of rape, she would become a shamed woman.
sentences.zh: 他知道，在任何情况下，如果一个未婚女孩或年轻女性失去了贞操，即使是被强奸，她也会成为一个蒙羞的女人。

sentences.en: The dishonour to herself and her family could then only be repaired through the matrimonio reparatore.
sentences.zh: 她本人及其家庭所受的耻辱，只能通过“补偿性婚姻”来修复。

sentences.en: To enact such a fuitina as the one Filippo was doing was most certainly a crime.
sentences.zh: 菲利波所做的这种“私奔”行为，无疑是一种犯罪。

sentences.en: But Filippo knew the law was on his side.
sentences.zh: 但菲利波知道法律站在他这一边。

sentences.en: Article 544 of the Criminal Code read, quote,
sentences.zh: 意大利刑法第544条写道，引用如下：

sentences.en: The crimes of kidnap and rape would be extinguished by the marriage between the victim and her rapiSt.
sentences.zh: 绑架和强奸罪，因受害者与其强奸犯之间的婚姻而消灭。

sentences.en: This law applied even if the victim was a minor.
sentences.zh: 即使受害者是未成年人，此法律同样适用。

sentences.en: At the beginning of January,
sentences.zh: 一月初，

sentences.en: Filippo covertly relocated Franca from the farmhouse to his sister's house in Alcamo.
sentences.zh: 菲利波秘密地将弗兰卡从农舍转移到了他位于阿尔卡莫的姐姐家中。

sentences.en: By this stage, the Melodia family had been in contact with the Viola family and negotiations were underway.
sentences.zh: 此时，梅洛迪亚家族已经与维奥拉家族取得了联系，谈判正在进行中。

sentences.en: Knowing full well what Filippo was up to with Franca, the two families were nearing an agreement on a wedding date.
sentences.zh: 两家人非常清楚菲利波对弗兰卡做了什么，他们正就婚期达成一致。

sentences.en: On Thursday, January 6, 1966,
sentences.zh: 1966年1月6日，星期四，

sentences.en: 12 days after Franca Viola was kidnapped,
sentences.zh: 在弗兰卡·维奥拉被绑架12天后，

sentences.en: Commissioner Lorenzo Camilleri and his officers had Filippo Melodia's sister's house surrounded.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐·卡米莱里警长及其警员包围了菲利波·梅洛迪亚姐姐的房子。

sentences.en: They demanded that Filippo release Franca immediately.
sentences.zh: 他们要求菲利波立即释放弗兰卡。

sentences.en: There was a commotion from inside the house and then suddenly, two figures appeared on the second story balcony.
sentences.zh: 屋内传来一阵骚动，突然，二楼阳台上出现了两个身影。

sentences.en: Filippo held up a visibly weak Franca Viola in front of him.
sentences.zh: 菲利波挡在身前，手里抓着虚弱不堪的弗兰卡·维奥拉。

sentences.en: As the officers levelled their guns at Filippo,
sentences.zh: 当警员们将枪口对准菲利波时，

sentences.en: Franca shouted,
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡大喊道：

sentences.en: Don't shoot!
sentences.zh: 别开枪！

sentences.en: The police lowered their weapons.
sentences.zh: 警察放下了武器。

sentences.en: Satisfied with this outcome,
sentences.zh: 对这个结果感到满意，

sentences.en: Filippo agreed to surrender Franca and watched as his teenage captive collapsed into the waiting arms of her father.
sentences.zh: 菲利波同意交出弗兰卡，并看着他那十几岁的俘虏瘫倒在她父亲等待的双臂中。

sentences.en: Filippo offered no resistance when Commissioner Camilleri placed him under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 当卡米莱里警长将他逮捕时，菲利波没有进行任何反抗。

sentences.en: He just smiled broadly and asked for a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 他只是咧嘴一笑，要了一支烟。

sentences.en: He believed she would insist that he be released and become her husband,
sentences.zh: 他相信她会坚持要求释放他并成为他的妻子，

sentences.en: as it was the only way she could remedy the disgrace she now brought upon her family as a dishonoured woman.
sentences.zh: 因为这是她作为一名蒙羞的女人，挽回给家庭带来耻辱的唯一途径。

sentences.en: Franca paused in front of Filippo Melodia, looked him in the eyes and told him,
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡在菲利波·梅洛迪亚面前停下脚步，直视他的眼睛说道：

sentences.en: I will never marry you.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会嫁给你。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Filippo's smile vanished and the police took him away.
sentences.zh: 菲利波的笑容消失了，警察将他带走。

sentences.en: Reunited with her family and safely back home,
sentences.zh: 与家人团聚并安全回到家中后，

sentences.en: Franca agonised over rumours that her father had agreed for her to be married to Filippo during her time in captivity.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡对那些传言感到痛苦，传言称她在被囚禁期间，父亲曾同意将她嫁给菲利波。

sentences.en: Bernardo assured his daughter that the marriage negotiations were just a ruse in order for Commissioner Camilleri to discover where she was being held.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多向女儿保证，婚姻谈判只是为了让卡米莱里警长查出她被关押地点的计谋。

sentences.en: With no marriage planned, Franca's fate, and that of her family, was uncertain.
sentences.zh: 由于没有婚约，弗兰卡和她家人的命运依然悬而未决。

sentences.en: Vita worried for her daughter's future, but Franca was confident in her decision.
sentences.zh: 维塔为女儿的未来感到担忧，但弗兰卡对自己的决定充满信心。

sentences.en: She insisted that she would rather remain unmarried her entire life than be married to a man such as Filippo Melodia, a man without honour.
sentences.zh: 她坚持认为，宁可终身不嫁，也不愿嫁给像菲利波·梅洛迪亚这样没有荣誉的男人。

sentences.en: In standing her ground, Franca had become the first Sicilian to ever refuse a matrimonio reparatore with her rapiSt.
sentences.zh: 通过坚持立场，弗兰卡成为了西西里岛历史上第一个拒绝与强奸犯进行“补偿性婚姻”的女性。

sentences.en: Bernardo Viola just wanted his daughter to be safe and happy, but he knew that the price for her resolve would be high.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多·维奥拉只希望女儿平安幸福，但他知道，她做出这个决定的代价将是巨大的。

sentences.en: In the months leading up to Filippo Melodia's trial, life for the Viola family was grim.
sentences.zh: 在菲利波·梅洛迪亚受审前的几个月里，维奥拉一家的生活十分凄惨。

sentences.en: The earlier destruction of their farm meant that they had little money and food was scarce.
sentences.zh: 他们之前的农场被毁，意味着他们几乎没有钱，食物也很匮乏。

sentences.en: Bernardo was desperate to find work, but no one in the town or surrounding villages would hire him.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多拼命想找工作，但镇上和周边村庄没有人愿意雇佣他。

sentences.en: Franca became reclusive, shutting herself inside her home to avoid hostilities and judgement from the public.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡变得孤僻，把自己关在家里，以避免公众的敌意和评判。

sentences.en: The Violas were guarded around the clock by police to ensure none of Filippo Melodia's family or friends followed through on their death threats.
sentences.zh: 维奥拉一家全天候受到警察保护，以确保菲利波·梅洛迪亚的家人或朋友不会真的实施死亡威胁。

sentences.en: Many of the townspeople admired Franca's courage, but they still considered her decision to be ill-advised.
sentences.zh: 许多镇民钦佩弗兰卡的勇气，但他们仍然认为她的决定是不明智的。

sentences.en: They believed that even a girl as pretty as Franca would never find a husband now.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，即使像弗兰卡这样漂亮的女孩，现在也永远找不到丈夫了。

sentences.en: Not only was she dishonoured, but she was also poor.
sentences.zh: 她不仅蒙受了耻辱，而且还很贫穷。

sentences.en: During a council meeting for the town of Alcamal, it was proposed that the council stand in solidarity with Franca, her family, and all others who had been bullied.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔卡莫镇的一次议会会议上，有人提议议会应声援弗兰卡、她的家人以及所有受欺凌的人。

sentences.en: The proposition was unanimously approved,
sentences.zh: 该提议获得了一致通过，

sentences.en: but when one counsellor stood up and rhetorically requested a show of hands as to who among them would be willing to marry any dishonoured woman, no one moved.
sentences.zh: 但当一名议员站起来，反问在座的人谁愿意娶一个蒙羞的女人时，没有人举手。

sentences.en: In December 1966, Franca Viola and her parents arrived at the Trapani Courthouse under armed police escort.
sentences.zh: 1966年12月，弗兰卡·维奥拉和她的父母在武装警察的护送下抵达特拉帕尼法院。

sentences.en: Of the 500 or so spectators who packed the courtroom, the vast majority were the family and supporters of Filippo Melodia and his accomplices.
sentences.zh: 在挤满法庭的约500名旁听者中，绝大多数是菲利波·梅洛迪亚及其同伙的家人和支持者。

sentences.en: The room was palpably hostile towards the Viola family, who endured the crowd's insults and death threats.
sentences.zh: 法庭内对维奥拉一家的敌意显而易见，他们忍受着人群的侮辱和死亡威胁。

sentences.en: Even their lawyer was met with jeers and spit.
sentences.zh: 甚至他们的律师也遭到了嘲笑和唾弃。

sentences.en: The Violas sat behind the public prosecutor and their own lawyer.
sentences.zh: 维奥拉一家坐在公诉人和他们自己的律师身后。

sentences.en: On the other side of the room were the lawyers representing each of the accused.
sentences.zh: 房间的另一边是代表每位被告的律师。

sentences.en: All 12 of the defendants, including Filippo Melodia, were present inside the courtroom, locked behind the defendants' bars.
sentences.zh: 包括菲利波·梅洛迪亚在内的所有12名被告都出现在法庭内，被锁在被告席的栅栏后。

sentences.en: Under oath, Filippo Melodia told the court that he and Franca Viola were in love and that her father, Bernardo, had called off their engagement against Franca's wishes.
sentences.zh: 菲利波·梅洛迪亚在宣誓后告诉法庭，他和弗兰卡·维奥拉是相爱的，是她的父亲贝尔纳多违背弗兰卡的意愿取消了他们的婚约。

sentences.en: He claimed that they had been consensually intimate many times during their escape, but it was old news, as they had already had sex two years prior during their initial courtship.
sentences.zh: 他声称他们在逃亡期间多次自愿发生亲密关系，但这已是旧闻，因为他们在两年前最初交往时就已经发生过性关系。

sentences.en: He elaborated, saying that there were moments during his visits to the Viola house where he and Franca were unsupervised.
sentences.zh: 他详细说明，在他访问维奥拉家期间，他和弗兰卡曾有独处的时刻。

sentences.en: To prove their client's assertions, Filippo's defence team requested that their medical expert be granted permission to physically examine Franca Viola,
sentences.zh: 为了证明其当事人的主张，菲利波的辩护团队请求法庭允许他们的医学专家对弗兰卡·维奥拉进行身体检查，

sentences.en: in order to prove that she lost her virginity many months or even years prior to the Fuitina.
sentences.zh: 以证明她在“私奔”前几个月甚至几年前就已经失去了贞操。

sentences.en: The prosecution vigorously objected to the request and it was ultimately denied by the court.
sentences.zh: 检方强烈反对这一请求，最终被法庭驳回。

sentences.en: Filippo also claimed that he and Franca had planned the details of the staged kidnapping the day prior, on Christmas Day.
sentences.zh: 菲利波还声称，他和弗兰卡在前一天，即圣诞节那天，就已经策划好了这场假绑架的细节。

sentences.en: In a show of solidarity with his co-accused, Filippo stated that while he had received assistance,
sentences.zh: 为了表示与同案被告的团结，菲利波表示，虽然他得到了帮助，

sentences.en: none of the other 11 men charged had been present at the time of the phony kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 但在那场虚假绑架发生时，其他11名被指控的男子均未在场。

sentences.en: He declined to name any of his actual helpers.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝透露任何实际协助者。

sentences.en: Given the Fuitina was an agreed-upon arrangement between himself and Franca, no actual kidnap or rape had been committed.
sentences.zh: 鉴于“私奔”是他与弗兰卡之间达成的协议，因此并未发生实际的绑架或强奸。

sentences.en: Filippo Melodia concluded that Franca's true wish was to marry him, but her tyrannical father would not allow it.
sentences.zh: 菲利波·梅洛迪亚总结说，弗兰卡的真实愿望是嫁给他，但她专横的父亲不允许。

sentences.en: After Filippo stepped down, the defence called a long procession of witnesses who supported his claiMs.
sentences.zh: 菲利波下台后，辩方传唤了一长串证人来支持他的说法。

sentences.en: One by one they provided alibis for each of Filippo's accomplices.
sentences.zh: 他们逐一为菲利波的每一位同伙提供了不在场证明。

sentences.en: Most were said to have been at work all day, some at home, one in the market in town, and one at the barbers.
sentences.zh: 大多数人声称整天都在工作，有的在家，一个在镇上的市场，还有一个在理发店。

sentences.en: In support of Filippo's claims that he and Franca were in love and the Fuitina had been pre-planned between them, the defence called a woman named Anna Lungaro.
sentences.zh: 为了支持菲利波关于他和弗兰卡相爱且“私奔”是预先策划好的说法，辩方传唤了一名名叫安娜·伦加罗的女子。

sentences.en: Anna lived next door to Filippo's sister and witnessed the brief standoff between Filippo and the police.
sentences.zh: 安娜住在菲利波姐姐隔壁，目睹了菲利波与警察之间短暂的对峙。

sentences.en: Anna testified that Franca had not shouted, don't shoot, in fear of her own safety, but had actually yelled, don't shoot, he is my husband,
sentences.zh: 安娜作证说，弗兰卡并没有因为担心自己的安全而喊“别开枪”，而是喊了“别开枪，他是我的丈夫”，

sentences.en: in order to protect the man she loved from the officer's bullets.
sentences.zh: 以此保护她所爱的男人免受警官子弹的伤害。

sentences.en: As the defence concluded their case, none of the 12 accused men in the defendant's cage seemed at all worried about their fate.
sentences.zh: 随着辩方结束陈述，被告席上的12名被告似乎一点也不担心自己的命运。

sentences.en: They talked and joked amongst themselves, smoked cigarettes, and laughed.
sentences.zh: 他们互相交谈、开玩笑、抽烟、大笑。

sentences.en: The prosecution's argument was simple.
sentences.zh: 检方的论点很简单。

sentences.en: In clear violation of the law, the 12 defendants had kidnapped Franca Viola and then Filippo Melodia had raped her multiple times.
sentences.zh: 12名被告明显违反法律，绑架了弗兰卡·维奥拉，随后菲利波·梅洛迪亚多次强奸了她。

sentences.en: The prosecution conceded that under Section 544 of the Criminal Code, these actions would cease to be crimes in relation to all defendants
sentences.zh: 检方承认，根据刑法第544条，如果弗兰卡·维奥拉嫁给菲利波·梅洛迪亚，

sentences.en: if and when Franca Viola married Filippo Melodia.
sentences.zh: 那么这些行为对所有被告来说将不再构成犯罪。

sentences.en: However, given Franca's continued refusal to do so, which was her right, the fact of the crimes remained.
sentences.zh: 然而，鉴于弗兰卡坚持拒绝这样做（这是她的权利），犯罪事实依然存在。

sentences.en: Whether in fear of physical reprisal or simply the social stigma, no one in the community was willing to testify on behalf of the Viola family.
sentences.zh: 无论是出于对身体报复的恐惧，还是仅仅因为社会污名，社区里没有人愿意为维奥拉一家作证。

sentences.en: The prosecution's case was limited to what those within the family claimed on the stand.
sentences.zh: 检方的案件仅限于家庭成员在证人席上的陈述。

sentences.en: Both Vita and Bernardo testified as to the events leading up to their daughter's abduction.
sentences.zh: 维塔和贝尔纳多都就导致女儿被绑架的事件作了证。

sentences.en: They confirmed that back in 1963,
sentences.zh: 他们证实，早在1963年，

sentences.en: Franca was indeed engaged to Filippo Melodia, albeit conditionally on the two becoming more acquainted.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡确实与菲利波·梅洛迪亚订了婚，尽管是以两人进一步了解为前提的。

sentences.en: After spending time with Filippo,
sentences.zh: 在与菲利波相处一段时间后，

sentences.en: Franca had realised that she did not want to marry him and so his proposal was rejected.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡意识到她不想嫁给他，因此拒绝了他的求婚。

sentences.en: Franca's parents testified to the campaign of intimidation and destruction that followed.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡的父母作证讲述了随后的恐吓和破坏活动。

sentences.en: Despite the defence's attempts to prove otherwise,
sentences.zh: 尽管辩方试图证明事实并非如此，

sentences.en: Vita maintained that all of Filippo's accomplices were in the courtroom that day.
sentences.zh: 维塔坚持认为菲利波的所有同伙那天都在法庭上。

sentences.en: Even though they had been wearing face coverings when they took her daughter,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们在带走她女儿时戴着面罩，

sentences.en: Vita was able to recognise all of those involved.
sentences.zh: 维塔还是认出了所有参与者。

sentences.en: Franca's aunt and grandmother both testified that they, along with Franca's parents and her brother Mariano, all enjoyed Christmas Day together.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡的姑妈和祖母都作证说，她们和弗兰卡的父母以及她的兄弟马里亚诺一起度过了圣诞节。

sentences.en: At no time did Franca have any interaction or conversation with Filippo as he had claimed.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡从未像菲利波所声称的那样与他有过任何互动或交谈。

sentences.en: Finally, Franca Viola sat in the witness box.
sentences.zh: 最后，弗兰卡·维奥拉坐上了证人席。

sentences.en: She described her ordeal at the hands of Filippo Melodia in clear and precise detail.
sentences.zh: 她清晰而精确地描述了她在菲利波·梅洛迪亚手中遭受的折磨。

sentences.en: She denied that the Fuitina had been pre-planned between them, maintaining that none of what she had endured was consensual.
sentences.zh: 她否认“私奔”是他们预先策划的，坚称她所遭受的一切都不是自愿的。

sentences.en: Franca firmly stated that she was not now or had ever been in love with Filippo Melodia.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡坚定地表示，她现在没有，也从来没有爱过菲利波·梅洛迪亚。

sentences.en: Franca was pressed as to why she had now gone against all tradition by refusing to marry Filippo and restore her own honour and the social standing of her family.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡被追问为什么她现在违背所有传统，拒绝嫁给菲利波以恢复自己的荣誉和家庭的社会地位。

sentences.en: She replied,
sentences.zh: 她回答说：

sentences.en: I am not the property of anyone.
sentences.zh: 我不是任何人的财产。

sentences.en: Honour is lost by those who do certain things, not those who suffer them.
sentences.zh: 荣誉是由做某些事的人失去的，而不是由遭受这些事的人失去的。

sentences.en: After providing her testimony,
sentences.zh: 作证后，

sentences.en: Franca stayed away from the courthouse for the remainder of the trial.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡在审判的剩余时间里远离了法院。

sentences.en: She could no longer face the endless intrusion of reporters and photographers, nor the constant demand by Filippo Melodia's supporters to drop the charges and marry him.
sentences.zh: 她无法再面对记者和摄影师无休止的打扰，也无法面对菲利波·梅洛迪亚的支持者不断要求她撤诉并嫁给他的压力。

sentences.en: Instead, Franca would rely on her father's reports of the day's proceedings.
sentences.zh: 相反，弗兰卡只能依靠父亲对当天庭审过程的转述。

sentences.en: Despite continued threats to his life,
sentences.zh: 尽管生命不断受到威胁，

sentences.en: Bernardo never missed a day of the trial.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多从未缺席过一天的庭审。

sentences.en: In their closing statement, the prosecution requested exemplary sentences for each of the defendants to illustrate to everyone that violence should not be rewarded.
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词中，检方要求对每位被告进行严厉判决，以向所有人表明暴力不应得到奖励。

sentences.en: They suggested that Filippo Melodia's accomplices receive sentences ranging from 4 months to 13 years, proportionate to their respective roles in the kidnap of Franca Viola.
sentences.zh: 他们建议菲利波·梅洛迪亚的同伙根据他们在绑架弗兰卡·维奥拉案中各自的角色，判处4个月至13年不等的刑期。

sentences.en: For Filippo himself, a sentence of 22 years and 10 months was put forward as deserving and juSt.
sentences.zh: 对于菲利波本人，建议判处22年零10个月的刑期，这是罪有应得的。

sentences.en: The defence continued to argue that no crime had been committed, as Franca was in on the entire plot.
sentences.zh: 辩方继续辩称没有犯罪发生，因为弗兰卡参与了整个阴谋。

sentences.en: But should the court find cause for a conviction, the defence said it would be unfair for Filippo Melodia to pay dearly for his actions committed
sentences.zh: 但如果法庭认为有理由定罪，辩方称，让菲利波·梅洛迪亚为他按照当时社会习俗所采取的行为付出沉重代价是不公平的。

sentences.en: in accordance with the social customs of the time.
sentences.zh: （接上句）所采取的行为。

sentences.en: On the seventh and final day of the trial, the presiding judges retired to deliberate the case.
sentences.zh: 在审判的第七天，也是最后一天，主审法官退庭审议此案。

sentences.en: To the local community and Sicily as a whole, the trial marked a potential turning point in their social history.
sentences.zh: 对于当地社区乃至整个西西里岛来说，这次审判标志着他们社会历史的一个潜在转折点。

sentences.en: At 5.30 that evening, the judges delivered their verdict.
sentences.zh: 当天傍晚5点30分，法官宣读了判决结果。

sentences.en: The court found resoundingly in favour of Franca Viola and sentenced Filippo Melodia to 11 years in prison for kidnap and rape.
sentences.zh: 法庭以压倒性优势支持弗兰卡·维奥拉，判处菲利波·梅洛迪亚11年监禁，罪名是绑架和强奸。

sentences.en: Eight out of his 11 accomplices also received prison sentences.
sentences.zh: 他的11名同伙中，有8人也被判处监禁。

sentences.en: The reaction of those in the courtroom was stunned silence.
sentences.zh: 法庭内的人们陷入了震惊的沉默。

sentences.en: Italian newspaper La Stampa reported,
sentences.zh: 意大利《新闻报》报道称：

sentences.en: And with Filippo Melodia, this lesson will be listened to by many other Sicilians, who, like it or not, will have to know that something new is stirring in our countryside.
sentences.zh: 随着菲利波·梅洛迪亚的判决，这一教训将被许多其他西西里人所铭记，无论他们喜欢与否，他们都必须知道，我们的乡村正在酝酿着新的变化。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持Casefile继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: As the courtroom emptied, reporters were able to briefly speak with the patriarch of the Melodia and Viola families.
sentences.zh: 随着法庭清场，记者们得以简短地采访了梅洛迪亚和维奥拉家族的族长。

sentences.en: Filippo Melodia's father, Vincenzo, indicated he was not at all worried about his son's conviction, as there was still time for the matrimonio reparatore.
sentences.zh: 菲利波·梅洛迪亚的父亲文森佐表示，他一点也不担心儿子的定罪，因为还有时间进行“补偿性婚姻”。

sentences.en: With such a marriage, the law allowed his son's crimes to fall away even after the sentence had been handed down.
sentences.zh: 通过这样的婚姻，法律允许他儿子的罪行即使在判决下达后也可以免除。

sentences.en: Vincenzo was upbeat, suggesting that the wedding could be arranged very quickly.
sentences.zh: 文森佐很乐观，建议婚礼可以很快安排好。

sentences.en: He stated,
sentences.zh: 他说道：

sentences.en: I really don't understand why Bernardo doesn't want to.
sentences.zh: 我真的不明白贝尔纳多为什么不愿意。

sentences.en: In his place, I would have married Franco and Filippo.
sentences.zh: 如果是我，我早就让弗兰卡和菲利波结婚了。

sentences.en: In contrast,
sentences.zh: 相比之下，

sentences.en: Bernardo Viola remained steadfast that his daughter would never marry Filippo Melodia.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多·维奥拉坚定地表示，他的女儿永远不会嫁给菲利波·梅洛迪亚。

sentences.en: The Viola family were simply keen to get on with their lives.
sentences.zh: 维奥拉一家只想继续他们的生活。

sentences.en: When asked about Franca's future,
sentences.zh: 当被问及弗兰卡的未来时，

sentences.en: Bernardo confirmed that she had obtained her driver's licence and was studying to become a typiSt.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多证实她已经拿到了驾照，正在学习成为一名打字员。

sentences.en: During the previous year,
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，

sentences.en: Franca had received dozens of letters of support for her decision not to marry her rapist and she had already received hundreds of written marriage proposals.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡收到了数十封支持她不嫁给强奸犯决定的信件，并且已经收到了数百份书面求婚。

sentences.en: Bernardo was confident that Franca would be just fine.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多相信弗兰卡会过得很好。

sentences.en: Immediately after the trial,
sentences.zh: 审判结束后不久，

sentences.en: Filippo Melodia's legal team appealed his sentence and in July 1967, they were marginally successful.
sentences.zh: 菲利波·梅洛迪亚的法律团队对他的判决提出了上诉，并于1967年7月取得了微小的成功。

sentences.en: Filippo's sentence was reduced to 10 years in prison with two years of supervised confinement.
sentences.zh: 菲利波的刑期减为10年监禁，外加两年监外监管。

sentences.en: It was still dark on the morning of Wednesday, December 4, 1968 as 20-year-old Franca Viola walked slowly down the aisle between the chapel's pews.
sentences.zh: 1968年12月4日星期三的早晨，天还没亮，20岁的弗兰卡·维奥拉缓缓走过教堂长椅间的过道。

sentences.en: A bouquet of orange blossoms stood out against her white satin and lace dress and her smile radiated through the white veil that covered her face.
sentences.zh: 一束橙花在她的白色缎面蕾丝婚纱衬托下格外显眼，她的笑容透过覆盖在脸上的白色面纱绽放开来。

sentences.en: At the end of the aisle was 25-year-old accountant
sentences.zh: 走廊尽头站着25岁的会计师

sentences.en: Giuseppe Ruizzi.
sentences.zh: 朱塞佩·鲁伊齐。

sentences.en: Franca and Giuseppe had gone to school together and had lost touch in the years that followed.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡和朱塞佩曾是同学，后来多年未曾联系。

sentences.en: They were reacquainted at a reunion between their families in 1966, right before Franca was about to face
sentences.zh: 1966年，在两家人的聚会上，他们重逢了，当时弗兰卡正准备

sentences.en: Filippo Melodia in court.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上面对菲利波·梅洛迪亚。

sentences.en: Franca was already dealing with the severe public scrutiny of that decision, so she had kept her courtship with Giuseppe a secret.
sentences.zh: 由于当时弗兰卡正承受着巨大的舆论压力，她对与朱塞佩的交往守口如瓶。

sentences.en: He became her rock, calling Franca regularly as she remained hidden away in her home waiting for updates on the trial from her father.
sentences.zh: 他成了她的精神支柱，在弗兰卡躲在家中等待父亲传回庭审消息时，他经常打电话给她。

sentences.en: After the stress and attention of that ordeal faded away,
sentences.zh: 在那场磨难带来的压力和关注逐渐消退后，

sentences.en: Giuseppe proposed.
sentences.zh: 朱塞佩向她求婚了。

sentences.en: At first, Franca refused.
sentences.zh: 起初，弗兰卡拒绝了。

sentences.en: She feared that Filippo Melodia would find out and have Giuseppe killed.
sentences.zh: 她担心菲利波·梅洛迪亚会发现并杀害朱塞佩。

sentences.en: However, Giuseppe persisted, telling Franca that he'd rather spend a short life as her husband than a whole life with any other woman.
sentences.zh: 然而，朱塞佩坚持不懈，告诉弗兰卡，他宁愿做她短暂的丈夫，也不愿与别的女人共度一生。

sentences.en: As soon as Franca accepted his proposal,
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡一答应求婚，

sentences.en: Giuseppe applied for the marriage licence and, as a contingency, a licence to carry.
sentences.zh: 朱塞佩就申请了结婚证，并作为应急措施，申请了持枪证。

sentences.en: Franca and Giuseppe opted to keep their wedding ceremony a small and private affair.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡和朱塞佩决定举行一场小型且私密的婚礼。

sentences.en: Only close friends and family were invited and the ceremony took place at dawn.
sentences.zh: 只有亲朋好友受邀参加，仪式在黎明时分举行。

sentences.en: A number of the police who had protected the violas in the lead-up to and during the trial were in attendance.
sentences.zh: 在庭审前夕及庭审期间保护过维奥拉一家的几名警察也出席了婚礼。

sentences.en: As was Franca's lawyer, who had become a close friend of the family since the trial.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡的律师也出席了，自庭审以来，他已成为该家族的挚友。

sentences.en: Franca and Giuseppe received congratulations and wedding gifts from the Italian president, Giuseppe Saragat, and from the Italian prime minister, Giovanni Leone.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡和朱塞佩收到了意大利总统朱塞佩·萨拉加特和意大利总理乔瓦尼·莱昂内的祝贺与结婚礼物。

sentences.en: As the sun rose on their nuptials, the newlyweds made their way to Rome for a private audience with the Pope.
sentences.zh: 在婚礼的晨曦中，这对新婚夫妇前往罗马，接受了教皇的私人接见。

sentences.en: After serving ten years for the kidnap and rape of Franca Viola,
sentences.zh: 因绑架和强奸弗兰卡·维奥拉而服刑十年后，

sentences.en: Filippo Melodia was released from prison.
sentences.zh: 菲利波·梅洛迪亚出狱了。

sentences.en: He was immediately transported to northern Italy, where he would be confined to the town of Mordena for the next two years to complete his sentence under supervised release.
sentences.zh: 他随即被押送至意大利北部，在那里他将被限制在莫德纳镇，接受为期两年的监督释放，以完成余下的刑期。

sentences.en: At no point did Filippo show any remorse for his crimes.
sentences.zh: 菲利波对自己犯下的罪行从未表现出任何悔意。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, April 12, 1978, after finishing his day's work at an auto body shop,
sentences.zh: 1978年4月12日，星期三，在汽车修理厂结束了一天的工作后，

sentences.en: 38-year-old Filippo Melodia made his way to a bar near his apartment.
sentences.zh: 38岁的菲利波·梅洛迪亚前往公寓附近的一家酒吧。

sentences.en: Still wearing his dirty work overalls, he sat down to watch a replay of the day's Champions League football match on the bar's television screen.
sentences.zh: 他穿着沾满油污的工作服，坐在酒吧的电视机前观看当天欧冠足球赛的重播。

sentences.en: Just after 8.30pm, the owner of the bar called out to Filippo from across the room, telling him that he had a phone call.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点30分刚过，酒吧老板隔着房间喊菲利波，说有他的电话。

sentences.en: A police marshal was on the other line,
sentences.zh: 电话那头是一位警官，

sentences.en: Filippo was told.
sentences.zh: 菲利波被告知。

sentences.en: He strode over to the phone and announced his presence down the receiver, but there was no response.
sentences.zh: 他大步走到电话旁，对着听筒自报家门，但对方没有任何回应。

sentences.en: Untroubled,
sentences.zh: 他没当回事，

sentences.en: Filippo hung up the phone and decided to head home.
sentences.zh: 挂断电话，决定回家。

sentences.en: As he went to leave, two men appeared and blocked his path.
sentences.zh: 正当他准备离开时，两名男子出现并挡住了他的去路。

sentences.en: One of the men lifted a shotgun and fired twice into Filippo's cheSt.
sentences.zh: 其中一人举起猎枪，对着菲利波的胸口连开两枪。

sentences.en: It was a textbook mafia execution.
sentences.zh: 这是一场教科书式的黑手党处决。

sentences.en: On Monday, December 19, 1966, less than 48 hours after Filippo Melodia was found guilty and sentenced to prison,
sentences.zh: 1966年12月19日，星期一，在菲利波·梅洛迪亚被判有罪并入狱不到48小时后，

sentences.en: 22-year-old Matea Traravalo was walking with her mother down a street in the Sicilian town of Salemi.
sentences.zh: 22岁的马泰娅·特拉拉瓦洛正与母亲走在西西里岛萨莱米镇的一条街道上。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, a car stopped alongside Matea and three men wrangled her into the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 突然，一辆车停在马泰娅身边，三名男子将她强行拖进车里。

sentences.en: Matea's mother was knocked to the ground and could do nothing but watch as the men drove away with her daughter.
sentences.zh: 马泰娅的母亲被撞倒在地，只能眼睁睁地看着这些人带走了她的女儿。

sentences.en: Matea was held captive and repeatedly raped by her ex-fiancée, Andrea Vietioso.
sentences.zh: 马泰娅被前未婚夫安德烈·维蒂奥索囚禁并多次强奸。

sentences.en: After four days, the police tracked down Matea to an empty cottage on the outskirts of town.
sentences.zh: 四天后，警方在镇郊的一间空屋里找到了马泰娅。

sentences.en: Andrea Vietioso insisted that no crime had been committed as Matea had agreed to marry him.
sentences.zh: 安德烈·维蒂奥索坚称自己没有犯罪，因为马泰娅已经同意嫁给他。

sentences.en: With the support of her family and emboldened by the courage and resolve of Franca Viola before her,
sentences.zh: 在家人的支持下，并受到弗兰卡·维奥拉勇气的鼓舞，

sentences.en: Matea denounced her rapiSt.
sentences.zh: 马泰娅举报了强奸犯。

sentences.en: She told the police that she had never agreed to run away with Andrea and that she would never marry him.
sentences.zh: 她告诉警方，她从未同意与安德烈私奔，也绝不会嫁给他。

sentences.en: Matea had Andrea Vietioso charged immediately.
sentences.zh: 马泰娅立即起诉了安德烈·维蒂奥索。

sentences.en: Twenty-four days later,
sentences.zh: 二十四天后，

sentences.en: 18-year-old Carmela Parisi was kidnapped in central Sicily and raped by Franco Matura.
sentences.zh: 18岁的卡梅拉·帕里西在西西里岛中部被绑架，并被佛朗哥·马图拉强奸。

sentences.en: Despite her family's wishes for her to marry her rapist,
sentences.zh: 尽管家人希望她嫁给强奸犯，

sentences.en: Carmela became the third Sicilian girl to refuse the convention.
sentences.zh: 卡梅拉成为了第三位拒绝这一传统的西西里女孩。

sentences.en: The floodgates had opened.
sentences.zh: 闸门已经打开。

sentences.en: Girls and young women throughout Sicily were now breaking the tradition that had punished them for centuries.
sentences.zh: 整个西西里岛的女孩和年轻女性开始打破这一惩罚了她们几个世纪的传统。

sentences.en: It took a further 15 years before the law that rewarded sexual violence with marriage was finally repealed.
sentences.zh: 又过了15年，这项以婚姻奖励性暴力的法律才最终被废除。

sentences.en: 66-year-old Franca Viola was awarded the honour of Grand Officer of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic by then-president
sentences.zh: 66岁的弗兰卡·维奥拉被时任总统授予意大利共和国功绩勋章大军官勋位，

sentences.en: Giorgio Napolitano.
sentences.zh: 乔治·纳波利塔诺。

sentences.en: Franca received the award for her brief but powerful contribution to the emancipation of women in Italy.
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡因其为意大利女性解放所作的短暂但有力的贡献而获此殊荣。

sentences.en: The following year,
sentences.zh: 次年，

sentences.en: Franca agreed to a rare interview with Italian newspaper
sentences.zh: 弗兰卡接受了意大利报纸《共和国报》的一次罕见采访，

sentences.en: La Repubblica in which she reflected on her life and experiences.
sentences.zh: 她在采访中回顾了自己的生活和经历。

sentences.en: She emphasised the importance of family support and explained the advice she had recently given to her granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 她强调了家庭支持的重要性，并讲述了她最近给孙女的建议。

sentences.en: Quote, You have to decide what is right, not what is convenient.
sentences.zh: 她说：“你必须决定什么是对的，而不是什么是方便的。”
